headline: Asian stock markets sink amid concerns over the tech sector | Novini.bg
summary: Asian stock markets declined on concerns over the technology sector, with indices of the Tokyo Stock Exchange plunging in the day's session.
why: The Tokyo Stock Exchange is Japan's main equity market and a bellwether for Asian equities. Tech-sector sentiment strongly influences regional index performance because of large chip and electronics weightings.
why_moved: Asian equities sold off amid concerns over the technology sector, according to the report.
